about: One docviz card and the money its calls spend. Moved from prototype/pr1-pipeline/model/ (PR #1's head).

steps.label: Before any helper call starts, it is refused if today’s budget is used up.

sources.to: // Every call is charged to the ledger

steps.label: When the card comes back, the call’s cost is recorded in the ledger and added to the card’s cost.

sources.to: // Every call is charged to the ledger

steps.label: When the call fails after spending, its cost is still recorded and added to the card as a failed attempt.

sources.to: // Every call is charged to the ledger

steps.label: When the helper reports no cost (a timeout), nothing is recorded or charged.

sources.to: // Every call is charged to the ledger

steps.label: Pressing Simpler is refused before the saved depth moves when today’s budget is used up; otherwise the depth moves and the card redraws.
Dismissing removes the card record, even while one of its calls is still running.
When a redraw comes back after its card was dismissed, the cost is recorded in the ledger but added to no card.
